stories.title: 61 calls, six arrests and a dog called Arlo: 24 hours with north Flintshire’s police
stories.summary: Police in north Flintshire dealt with 61 calls in 24 hours, made six arrests and introduced a four-legged colleague, in the team’s latest morning briefing. stories.title: North Wales Police renew summer road safety appeal following fatal motorcycle collision
stories.summary: North Wales Police have renewed their summer road safety appeal after 13 fatal collisions on the region’s roads so far this year, seven of them involving motorcycles. stories.title: Boccard UK’s Deeside site to build tanks for £5bn Sizewell C project
stories.summary: Sizewell C has awarded a contract to Boccard UK to manufacture stainless steel tanks at its Deeside facility. The company said the contract covers the fabrication and pre-assembly of high-integrity tanks, which will be built into reinforced concrete structures across Sizewell C’s Nuclear Island. stories.title: Senedd committees finalised as eight-week summer recess begins
stories.summary: Senedd Members have taken up their positions in Cardiff Bay, with parliamentary committees now in full swing as the Welsh Parliament enters its eight-week summer recess. stories.title: Chester Zoo releases 32 critically endangered newts at secret Spanish site
stories.summary: Newts bred at Chester Zoo have been released into the wild at a secret site in Catalonia as part of an international effort to save the species from extinction.
